expectations.text: Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced (no v1/v2 or side-by-side alternates)
expectations.evidence: Files are named spec.md and rubric.md, not SPECS.md/RUBRIC.md; no established naming contract.

expectations.text: SPECS.md contains all required sections: Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions
expectations.evidence: spec.md has Problem Statement/Goals/Non-Goals/Inputs/Output/Processing Rules/Edge Cases/Open Questions, but has no dedicated Trigger conditions section addressing near-misses, and 'Open Questions for Future Versions' is about deferred features, not stated assumptions.

expectations.text: SPECS.md content is specific to meeting-notes-to-action-items (not generic boilerplate)
expectations.evidence: Includes a worked example, anti-hallucination rule, and owner/due-date extraction rules specific to this task.

expectations.text: RUBRIC.md's first criterion is triggering accuracy and covers both firing correctly and staying quiet on near-misses
expectations.evidence: rubric.md's criteria are Bucketing Accuracy, Format Compliance, Completeness, Deduplication, Clarity, Grouping Correctness plus two fabrication/ambiguity gates — no criterion addresses when the skill should or shouldn't fire at all.

expectations.text: RUBRIC.md has 4-6 criteria total, each traceable to a specific part of SPECS.md, plus an Overall score section
expectations.evidence: 8 total items (2 hard gates + 6 scored criteria) on a 0-3/18-point sum, with a 'Scoring Summary' band table rather than a holistic 'Overall score (out of 10)' prose paragraph.

expectations.text: Transcript shows a self-evaluation pass (Step 5) happening before the documents are presented as final
expectations.evidence: No self-critique or gap-finding pass described — documents were delivered directly after the clarifying-question round.

expectations.text: Transcript shows at least one round of simulated user feedback followed by a revision (Step 6 loop actually exercised)
expectations.evidence: Single-pass delivery; no revision round occurred.

expectations.text: No SKILL.md-style content (frontmatter, imperative build instructions) appears anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: No SKILL.md frontmatter or build instructions found.
